title: Phone: Mayor — is the water safe?

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Mayor
transcript.text: Denise, Robert Kline. Channel 4 wants me on camera at noon and the first question will be whether the water is safe.

transcript.speaker: Mayor
transcript.text: Gloria tells me the hackers are in the plant computers. I need a yes or no, and I need to know whether to tell people to buy bottled water.

snapshot.title: Phone Call: Mayor — Water Safety Inquiry

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Denise, this is Robert Kline, the Mayor. I’ve just been asked by a reporter whether the water is safe. The city’s official channels are down. I need a yes or no answer. Is the water safe to drink?

transcript.speaker: Callee
transcript.text: The City is investigating a technology issue affecting the control system. We are running the plant manually and testing water quality every two hours. We will issue a public advisory when the facts are confirmed.

voiceStyles.Caller: Male in his 50s, calm but urgent, background city noise
voiceStyles.Callee: Female in her 40s, composed, measured, professional

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject tests the IC's adherence to approved messaging under pressure. Watch for any deviation from the scripted response or premature disclosure of water safety.
